<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns a paginated list of loyalty point transactions for a customer, covering both
earn and burn events. Use this to build a points history view in your app or customer
portal. Supports pagination (`recordsPerPage`, `pageNumber`), sort direction
(`sortingOrder`), and filtering by transaction type (`transactionType`). Set
`beansExpiryAfterDays` to surface only transactions where points are due to expire
within a given window — useful for driving proactive redemption nudges.
